text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- All Zimbabwean parastatals with a commercial focus will be expected to pay corporate tax and dividends as the government takes measures to increase its revenue collection, President Robert Mugabe said on Tuesday.
- Thousands of people thronged outside parliament on Tuesday to witness the opening of the third session of the fourth parliament of Zimbabwe.
- Zimbabwe's cellphone subscriber population is set to grow and the quality of service has improved with extra features now available on the service run by the Posts and Telecommunications Corp.
